title: Qwen3.8 open weights announcement
brief: Alibaba's announcement that Qwen3.8's open weights are out. Announcement-only; pair with the unsloth GGUF quant below for local runs.
details: Qwen3.8 open-weights announcement (from the @alibaba_qwen X account, Aug 2026) — the announcement post for the Qwen3.8 open-weight release: Qwen3.8-27B, a 27B dense native vision-language model (text, images, video in), released under Apache 2.0, alongside the weights of the flagship Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B MoE (2.4T total / 95B active, under a custom Qwen3.8-Max license with commercial revenue conditions). Qwen3.8-27B highlights: 262K native context (YaRN-extensible to 1M), thinking mode on by default with per-request disable and `reasoning_effort` control, stronger autonomous planning and environment feedback for long-horizon agentic work; Alibaba claims 61.7 on SWE-bench Pro and Terminal Bench 2.1 gains over Qwen3.6 (maker-reported, independent validation pending). The ecosystem picked it up fast: Unsloth GGUFs, Ollama builds, OpenRouter routes, and top-5 most-liked on Hugging Face within two days. (x.com is not directly fetchable from this environment; the release details above are corroborated from the public model cards and independent coverage, not from the post itself.)
